name: Varian Wrynn
shortDescription: Stormwind’s missing king, named by Slim as the absent diplomat. The portrait is a documentary subject image, not a claim that he is present in the depicted scenes.
body: Stormwind’s missing king, named by Slim as the absent diplomat. The portrait is a documentary subject image, not a claim that he is present in the depicted scenes. The original generated portrait is an interpretive research illustration, not a canonical model. It is a documentary subject portrait of an absent person, never a claim of physical presence at Menethil or Theramore.
